regions.merged_text: Many thanks for your kind favor of yesterday - Glad things are coming on favorably. Hope the your tiny niece shakes off that whooping, etc. Keep well yourself but shake off some of that anxiety about your and others' health. Thank God I am feeling fine again. Hope you can shortly say the same. Before laying your letter aside and then forgetting I tho't I'd just drop you a card - then spoild it. -
